Cerro Colorado
historical
Der Cerro Colorado ist ein rötlicher Küstenhügel auf der Paracas-Halbinsel, auf dem antike indigene Schachtgräber und archäologische Artefakte entdeckt wurden.
A Cerro Colorado egy vöröses tengerparti domb a Paracas-félszigeten, ahol ősi őslakos akna-sírokat és régészeti leleteket fedeztek fel.
Cerro Colorado este un deal de coastă roșiatic pe Peninsula Paracas, unde au fost descoperite morminte indigene antice de tip puț și artefacte arheologice.
Cerro Colorado is a reddish coastal hill on the Paracas Peninsula where ancient indigenous shaft tombs and archaeological artifacts have been discovered.
Wari Kayan
historical
Die Nekropole Wari Kayan ist eine bedeutende Stätte der Paracas-Kultur, berühmt für Hunderte von Mumien, die in extrem feine, farbenprächtige Textilien gehüllt sind.
A Wari Kayan nekropolisz a Paracas-kultúra egyik legfontosabb lelőhelye, amely rendkívül finom, színes textíliákba burkolt több száz múmiájáról híres.
Necropola Wari Kayan este un important sit al culturii Paracas, faimos pentru sutele de mumii înfășurate în textile colorate și extrem de fine.
The Wari Kayan necropolis is a major Paracas culture site, famous for yielding hundreds of mummies wrapped in exceptionally fine, colorful textiles.
Museo de Sitio de la Cultura Paracas
museum

Acest muzeu de lângă situl arheologic expune cranii deformate intenționat, ceramică antică și textile rafinate recuperate din nisipurile deșertului Paracas.
This site museum displays intentionally elongated skulls, ancient ceramics, and exquisite textiles recovered from the surrounding Paracas desert sands.

natural

This coastal viewpoint overlooks the shallow waters of the Paracas Reserve, offering visitors a prime vantage point to observe Chilean flamingos feeding in the bay.

historical

Mirado La Cathedral
natural
